definitions.explanation: A Tendai Buddhist temple in Hiraizumi, Iwate, traditionally founded in 850 by the monk Ennin and greatly expanded in the early 12th century under the Ōshū Fujiwara clan and famous for its gold-leaf hall, the Konjikidō. Part of the Hiraizumi World Heritage site.

{中尊寺|ちゅうそんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金色堂|こんじきどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{金箔|きんぱく}→金箔：31784_kinpaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覆|おお}われている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中尊寺|ちゅうそんじ}{金色堂|こんじきどう}: the Konjikidō (Golden Hall) of Chūson-ji
- {平泉|ひらいずみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中尊寺|ちゅうそんじ}: Chūson-ji in Hiraizumi

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Konjikidō, completed in 1124, holds the mummified remains of four generations of the Ōshū Fujiwara. Matsuo Bashō visited on his journey of ⟦{奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち}→奥の細道：31063_okunohosomichi⟧ and wrote of it: ⟦{五月雨|さみだれ}→五月雨：05930_samidare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{降|ふ}り{残|のこ}してや{光堂|ひかりどう}. Hiraizumi was listed as a World Heritage site in 2011.
